access_links.note: Alternate-format item metadata agrees on publisher and resource scope. Distribution content was not downloaded or compared.

access_note: Public metadata was readable without authentication. Data queries, download access and service operation were not tested. The source states Creative Commons Attribution 4.0, with accuracy and completeness caveats.
description: KiwiRail publishes recognised locations on its railway network, including passenger stations, yards, operational areas and named places. Attributes identify name, status and priority. The data do not identify freight stops, and historical locations are excluded. Points indicate the general vicinity; they do not establish precise asset boundaries. Feature-service and WFS items describe the same location resource; these locations are distinct from bridge, tunnel and track-asset geometries. Coverage is New Zealand. Access is through the published ArcGIS feature service and alternate item listings. Licence and cost: The source states Creative Commons Attribution 4.0, with accuracy and completeness caveats. Caveats: only item, service and layer metadata were inspected. No feature records were downloaded, and current completeness, geometric quality and operational availability remain untested. Access charges are not stated in the inspected metadata. The resource provides mapped infrastructure or service inputs; applying it in a simulation requires checking the source limits and relevant model assumptions. Related resources include the existing KiwiRail network-risk and freight-disruption layers.
